settings.title: Settings
settings.onDeviceSub: Photos are analyzed securely; scans may be kept to improve recognition
settings.clearDataSub: Delete saved meals on this device
settings.clearDataConfirmBody: This removes meal history from this device. It cannot be undone.
settings.rtlRestartBody: Changing language direction needs a full app reload to apply correctly.
settings.aboutBody: Get Calo recognizes food, drinks, and grocery items, then estimates calories and macros. If the match is wrong, pick from the catalog.
settings.privacy: Scan photos are sent securely for analysis. Get Calo may keep scan photos and labels to train and improve food recognition. Meal history stays on this device unless you clear it. No account is required.
settings.privacyBulletCamera: Camera access is used only when you choose to scan a meal.
settings.privacyBulletCloud: Photos are sent securely for analysis. Scans (image + labels) may be stored to improve Get Calo recognition.
settings.privacyBulletTraining: Training data is linked only to an anonymous device id — not your name or account.
settings.privacyBulletHistory: Meal history stays on this device until you clear it.
settings.privacyBulletAccount: No account is required to use Get Calo.
